Shopping list.name: Slime tire sealant, 24 oz
description: Truck/SUV size for the 235/65R17 tires. One bottle per tire to be treated. Check the chart on the bottle.

Shopping list.name: Tire plug kit
description: For tread punctures. A plug does nothing for a sidewall cut, which is what FSR gravel actually does.

Shopping list.name: 12V compressor
description: To reinflate after a plug, and to air back up after dropping pressure for washboard.

Shopping list.name: MotoMaster Overland Traction Aid, 2-pc
description: $69.99. 22.75 x 12.5 in each; the two couple together into a single run of about 45 in, with the joint acting as a flex point. Crush tested to 10 tons.

Shopping list.name: Recovery strap, 2 in x 30 ft
description: 15,000 lb is the right size for a 2,182 kg GVWR. Needs a rated recovery point at both ends — this vehicle has no front hooks, so the attachment point is unresolved.

Shopping list.name: Soft shackle
description: Not carried by Canadian Tire. A steel bow shackle becomes a projectile if something lets go, which is the reason to buy this elsewhere.

Shopping list.name: Fire extinguisher
description: Check the current BC fire season rules before each trip; requirements change by year and by fire centre.

Shopping list.name: Plywood offcut, 12 x 12 in
description: Jack base. The factory scissor jack sinks in gravel. Canadian Tire sells nothing purpose-made for this; 3/4 in plywood beats everything they do sell.

What goes in the Bronco.name: VHF resource road radio
description: Already owned. Programmed for the Coast and North Island channels — see the logging page for the channel maps.

What goes in the Bronco.name: inReach
description: Already owned. Cell coverage ends quickly outside the Campbell River corridor.

What goes in the Bronco.name: Gaia, maps downloaded
description: Already owned. Downloaded before leaving, since the data goes away.

What goes in the Bronco.name: Factory spare and jack
description: Stock. The spare is 225/65R17, narrower and lower rated than the 235/65R17 on the ground — good to limp out on, not to drive an FSR on.

What goes in the Bronco.name: Traction boards
description: With the shovel, this is the self-recovery kit. Dig ahead of the tires, seat the boards, ease on.

What goes in the Bronco.name: Recovery strap and soft shackle
description: Only useful with a second vehicle. On an active FSR a logging truck or another traveller stopping is likely.

What goes in the Bronco.name: Water for a night, warm layers
